# Native `.veskra` document fixtures

**Provenance:** every file here is generated by Veskra's own test code
(`crates/veskra-format/tests/fixtures.rs` + builders in `crates/veskra-format/tests/common/mod.rs`).
Content is synthetic (procedural soft discs, synthetic stroke samples, Veskra-generated sRGB ICC
profile from `veskra-color`). No third-party artwork, brushes or profiles. License: same as the
repository (MIT OR Apache-2.0).

| File | Schema | Expected result |
|---|---|---|
| `simple-1-layer.veskra` | 1 | Loads; equals `simple_document()` (1 raster layer, 1 stroke with tilt/azimuth/rotation axes). |
| `12-layer-illustration.veskra` | 1 | Loads; equals `twelve_layer_document()` (10 pixel layers incl. vector-stroke layers, 1 isolated + 1 pass-through group, clipping, all v1 blend modes, selection). |
| `corrupt-manifest.veskra` | — | `CorruptData`: `manifest.json` is truncated JSON (integrity.json otherwise consistent). |
| `future-schema.veskra` | 2 (`minReader` 2) | `UnsupportedSchema`; `inspect` reports `schema_supported = false`; file never modified. |
| `truncated.veskra` | — | `CorruptData`: first 60 % of `simple-1-layer.veskra` (no end-of-central-directory). |

These are a **format-compatibility guard**: if the encoder changes, these committed files must still
load to the same documents. Regenerate only for an intentional, reviewed change (and add the old
file as a migration fixture if the schema changes):

```sh
VESKRA_REGEN_FIXTURES=1 cargo test -p veskra-format --test fixtures
```

Generation is deterministic (fixed ZIP timestamps, sorted entries, fixed `created` string), so
regenerating without a code change produces byte-identical files. Each file must stay < 200 KB.
